name: track random irregularity
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 作为随机过程或随机场描述的轨道几何偏差。
usage_overview: 通常作为车辆—轨道系统的随机几何激励，用于分析轮轨相互作用及动力响应的概率特征，也可与横风、车轮磨耗或扣件失效共同考虑。参数比较与优化分析中可采用相同不平顺样本，以比较不同参数组合下的响应。

complete_examples.text: The results in Figure 6 clearly prove that the method developed to simulate the track random irregularity in the temporal–spatial dimension effectively describes the probabilistic characteristics of track random irregularity.

Track random irregularity Probabilistic model Vehicle/track coupled dynamics Probability density evolution method a b s t r a c t Track irregularities generally viewed as weak stationary random processes are perhaps the most important excitations to the vehicle/track coupled system.

Though, there are signs that the probabilistic feature of track random irregularity is mentioned in [17,18], but how to model the realistic track random irregularities by being integrated with probability theory, and meanwhile, to rationally express the relationships between track geometries and dynamic behaviours of the system in probabilities, still needs more investigations.

With regarding to numerical analysis, the computations are generally discretized, thus the track random irregularity samples in Eq. (30), in other words, are composed of many deterministic excitation samples endowed with probabilistic property.
